direction_change: The original 16-update heldout action policies all chose balanced replay. Here the target is the minimum qualifying number of balanced updates, not the largest final utility. This pilot contains no predictor fitting and authorizes no TEST actions.
features: Reuse the original acquired-checkpoint tuned lenses trained on disjoint TRAIN background activations, along with frozen lens, output and confidence readouts. Source receipts bind fitting and frozen probes. Copy baseline observations, features and existing TRAIN outcomes before new repair updates. These are diagnostic readouts only, never optimization targets.

future_holdout.required: New intent cohorts, independent stream seeds/orders, original acquisition/forgetting prerequisites, predictor fitting on TRAIN only, all source groups kept clustered in evaluation. Do not reuse observed TEST as fresh. Minimum-budget prediction and continuous utility prediction must be separated from policy gain and compared with constant TRAIN baselines.

gate.failure: no_identifiable_prediction_task; do not fit predictors or run TEST. Any changed budget, schedule or threshold needs another new TRAIN-only protocol.
gate.pass: Prepare newly selected disjoint intent cohorts and a separately sealed prediction protocol. Passing does not authorize heldout dispatch from this runner.
gate.rule: Require at least two minimum-budget classes with >=2 TRAIN skills each, counting never if observed, with all eligible units from both preregistered TRAIN streams. Utility range alone cannot pass.

inference_boundaries: Minimum repair budget is a response measurement, not proof of stored-binding reuse. The original matched retain-only references nearly saturate at 16 balanced updates. Recovery-speed claims require matched retain-only curves at these smaller budgets. Independent units are source streams, not intents, layers or label permutations.

label_permutations.rule: Seal 40 index permutations before pilot updates: 20 within-source and 20 pooled TRAIN draws. For each target (minimum budget and each budget recovery/utility), record changed-label counts; keep inert draws and never silently redraw. Whole paired outcome vectors use the same permutation. These plans support later multiple null fits; this pilot fits none. No heldout labels enter permutations.

learning_gates.acquisition_baseline: At least .3 improvement from start of the relevant training phase: initial old-gate scores for old acquisition; acquired-checkpoint new-gate scores for later-task acquisition. Never count a pre-existing output-code bias as a newly learned binding.

minimum_budget_rule: Among 2,4,8,16 choose the smallest budget meeting unchanged native-code accuracy >=.8, gain >=.3 from forgotten TEST-row baseline, and newer-guard drop <=.1. Use never if none qualifies. Do not assume monotonic recovery; retain later losses of qualification. These are TRAIN prediction-cohort units even when their outcome utterances come from CLINC TEST rows.
name: train-minimum-balanced-repair-budget-20260912
prerequisites: Independently recompute both TRAIN sources from gate-validation native code logits and verify immutable source receipts, mechanisms and features before loading a model. Old acquisition must reach .8 and gain .3; forgetting requires drop .3 and final <=.5, with genuinely acquired new tasks. Retain every eligible TRAIN intent; no selection on pilot outcomes or already observed TEST outcomes.
question: Which smallest measured balanced-replay budget first qualifies recovery of an acquired then forgotten intent-code binding?

repair.controls: Re-observe both acquired and forgotten baselines before any update; no-action reset restores the forgotten baseline after each skill. The original 16-update result is a positive reproducibility anchor. Original none, restore, sham and target-only outcomes are retained in source-outcomes-frozen.json; they are not additional arms of this pilot.
repair.optimizer: Fresh AdamW per independent arm, source lr .0003, clip 1, weight decay 0. All existing rank-8 LoRA parameters, no backbone changes.
repair.prefix_proof: Save and compare exact adapter hashes, losses, gradient norms and row traces at common 2/4/8/16 boundaries. Optimizer is continuous across boundaries inside an arm and fresh across arms. Verify saved/reloaded outcomes and reproduce the original 16-update balanced result exactly.
repair.schedule: Generate one 16-update schedule with the exact original stream/intent repair seed. Each arm starts at the same forgotten adapter and uses that actual prefix, 4 old + 4 newer repair rows per update. Independent budgets use 30 updates total per intent.

scope: TRAIN-only protocol development in bounded original 16-code CLINC classification. Skills are learned intent-to-code bindings; semantic intent erasure is not measured.
